title.sr: Provizija za paket sa preporukom partnera
title.en: Commission on a package bought via a partner referral

intro.sr: Kad se paket kupi preko partnerovog koda za preporuku, dva popusta se kombinuju: kupon partnera i ugrađen popust samog paketa. Sistem mora ispravno da izračuna proviziju i partnera (na osnovu stvarno naplaćenog) i zaposlenog (proporcionalno prema pravoj, nepopustovanoj vrednosti usluge) - ovo je stvarna poslovna pravila iz interne dokumentacije, ne izmišljen primer.
intro.en: When a package is bought through a partner's referral code, two discounts combine: the partner's coupon and the package's own built-in discount. The system has to correctly calculate commission for both the partner (based on what was actually paid) and the employee (proportional to the service's true, undiscounted value) - this is a real business rule from the internal docs, not a made-up example.

prijava.sr: Klijent se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
prijava.en: The customer logs into their account.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje da bi dodelio paket.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs in to assign the package.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom u gornjem desnom uglu.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name in the top-right corner.

admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.sr: Administrator bira „Admin panel” iz menija, čime se otvara admin deo sajta.
admin-ulazak-otvara-admin-panel.en: The admin picks "Admin panel" from the menu, opening the site's admin area.

admin-paketi-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Katalog” u admin meniju.
admin-paketi-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Catalog" group in the admin menu.

admin-paketi-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Purchased packages" from the menu.

heading.en: Assign the package with a partner coupon

admin-dodeljuje-paket-sa-kuponom.sr: Administrator bira klijenta i paket, unosi kod partnerovog kupona - popust se primenjuje odmah na kupovinu paketa.
admin-dodeljuje-paket-sa-kuponom.en: The admin picks the customer and package, enters the partner's coupon code - the discount applies immediately to the package purchase.

heading.en: Book a session from the package

klijent-rezervise-seansu.sr: Klijent zakazuje termin, plaćajući iz već kupljenog paketa - bez dodatne naplate.
klijent-rezervise-seansu.en: The customer books an appointment, paying from the already-purchased package - no additional charge.

admin-termini-otvara-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na grupu „Zakazivanje” u admin meniju.
admin-termini-otvara-meni.en: The admin clicks the "Scheduling" group in the admin menu.

admin-termini-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Appointments" from the menu.

admin-termini-pretraga.sr: Administrator pretražuje listu po email adresi klijenta.
admin-termini-pretraga.en: The admin searches the list by the customer's email.

admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.sr: Administrator otvara termin koji klijent zakazao iz paketa.
admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin opens the appointment the customer booked from the package.

admin-zavrsava-termin.sr: Administrator potvrđuje pa završava termin - ovo je trenutak kad se obračunava provizija zaposlenog, ispravno proporcionalna kombinovanom popustu.
admin-zavrsava-termin.en: The admin confirms then completes the appointment - this is when the employee's commission is calculated, correctly proportional to the combined discount.
